title: The Billionaire Who Wanted to Die Broke
hook_text: HE GAVE AWAY 8 BILLION DOLLARS IN SECRET

beats.say: Chuck Feeney made billions building Duty Free Shoppers, but he wore a $15 plastic watch.
beats.visual: A close-up of a cheap plastic watch resting on a worn wooden table, dim warm lighting, cinematic depth of field.

beats.say: He flew coach, ate at local diners, and rented a modest apartment.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a man walking down a narrow airplane aisle carrying a worn canvas bag, soft window light.

beats.say: So why did a man with access to endless luxury choose to live like a student?
beats.visual: A person sitting at a plain wooden desk reviewing papers by the light of a single desk lamp, dark room.

beats.say: Most people assume billionaires hoard every cent to build an untouchable dynasty for their kids.
beats.visual: A heavy iron safe door swinging open slowly, revealing stacks of dark shadows inside, moody cinematic light.

beats.say: Instead, Feeney quietly transferred his entire $8 billion fortune to charity while he was still alive.
beats.visual: An old fountain pen signing a blank white document on a dark desk, shallow focus, dramatic overhead angle.

beats.say: How do you give away a massive empire without anyone noticing for decades?
beats.visual: A hand sliding a plain manila envelope across a polished wooden table, high contrast, film noir style.

beats.say: He used anonymous foundations and strict secrecy clauses so recipients never knew his name.
beats.visual: A modern glass building exterior reflecting a cloudy sky at dusk, muted cool tones, architectural view.

beats.say: He believed wealth shouldn't sit in a vault when it could solve problems right now.
beats.visual: A rusty metal padlock hanging on an old wooden gate, late afternoon sun casting long shadows.

beats.say: Feeney officially achieved his goal in 2016 when his net worth hit zero.
beats.visual: A digital alarm clock flashing zeros in a dark room, glowing red numbers, still life photography.

beats.say: True wealth management isn't about how much you accumulate, but how much good you do with it.
beats.visual: An empty coffee cup sitting on a sunny windowsill, peaceful morning light, minimalist composition.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A person walking away down a quiet city street into a soft morning fog, wide cinematic shot.

caption: Chuck Feeney gave away $8 billion in total secrecy while living a modest life. The ultimate lesson in wealth. #moneypk #personalfinance #wealth #frugalliving #moneyrules
